rows.corpus_definition: the normal way that you do things every day.
rows.example_en: My morning routine takes about thirty minutes.

rows.corpus_definition: Things you do in the same way every single day.
rows.example_en: My morning routine always includes a cup of coffee.

rows.corpus_definition: To move your hand back and forth over a surface.
rows.example_en: Please rub some lotion on your dry hands.

rows.corpus_definition: Not being nice or kind to other people.
rows.example_en: It is rude to talk while eating.

rows.corpus_definition: To spoil or destroy something completely.
rows.example_en: The rain will ruin our picnic.

rows.corpus_definition: Information spread by people that may not be true.
rows.example_en: I heard a rumor about the new boss.

rows.corpus_definition: information that people share but that may not be true
rows.example_en: I heard a rumor that the school will close.

rows.corpus_definition: To have nothing left of something.
rows.example_en: We will run out of milk soon.

rows.corpus_definition: To travel across water using a boat.
rows.example_en: We plan to sail across the ocean next summer.

rows.corpus_definition: The activity of using a boat with a sheet for travel.
rows.example_en: Sailing is a very relaxing hobby for me.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who works or travels on a ship.
rows.example_en: The sailor navigated the ship through the storm.

rows.corpus_definition: Fixed regular payments made by an employer to an employee.
rows.example_en: She receives her salary every month.

rows.corpus_definition: the money you get for doing your job every month
rows.example_en: He gets a good salary at the bank.
